subject: CS
title: Introduction to Computer Science 1
description: Introduction to designing programs. The use of a functional programming language to teach fundamental concepts including recursion, conditionals, lists, and trees. Emphasis on systematic program design and testing.
prerequisites: High school algebra and basic math skills
notes: Intended for students with little or no programming background

subject: CS
title: Introduction to Computer Science 2
description: Continuation of CS 115. Introduction to imperative programming, including state, assignment, loops, and input/output. Use of libraries and modular programming.

subject: CS
title: Designing Functional Programs
description: Introduction to programming and computing using a functional programming language. Emphasis on recursion, abstraction, higher-order functions, and correctness.
notes: For students with strong math background

subject: CS
title: Elementary Algorithm Design and Data Abstraction
description: Introduction to imperative programming and elementary data structures. Topics: arrays, pointers, dynamic memory, linked lists, trees, recursion, sorting, searching, and algorithm analysis.

subject: CS
title: Designing Functional Programs (Advanced)
description: Accelerated version of CS135 for mathematically strong students. Covers functional programming, recursion, abstraction, higher-order functions, and formal proofs of program correctness.
prerequisites: Admission by invitation or consent of instructor
notes: Intended for students with very strong mathematical background

subject: CS
title: Elementary Algorithm Design and Data Abstraction (Advanced)
description: Accelerated version of CS136. Topics include imperative programming, advanced recursion, data abstraction, and complexity analysis. More depth and breadth than CS136.

subject: CS
title: Introduction to Computers and Computer Systems
description: Introduction to computer systems: hardware, operating systems, and software. Topics include representation of data, machine language, assembly programming, memory hierarchy, and basic operating system concepts.

subject: CS
title: Algorithm Design and Data Abstraction
description: Introduction to more advanced data structures and algorithms. Topics include ADTs, abstract specification, algorithmic strategies, trees, graphs, sorting, searching, and complexity analysis.

subject: CS
title: Data Types and Structures
description: Design and implementation of data structures, including stacks, queues, lists, trees, and graphs. Introduction to algorithm analysis and efficiency.

subject: CS
title: Logic and Computation
description: Introduction to formal logic and its applications in computer science. Propositional and predicate logic, proofs, and logic programming.
